nodes.title: State the claim
nodes.body:
Population identity, developmental order,
or donor-variable organisation

nodes.title: Check reference consistency
nodes.body:
Check roots, lineages and finite-cell coverage.
Separate reversal from reordered distances.

nodes.title: Choose an analytical representation
nodes.body:
PCA/GLM-PCA baseline; suitable count-model latents.
Choose dimension; keep the 2D display separate.

nodes.title: Check the task outcome
nodes.body:
Per-label F1, order agreement, or cell-type
and donor information reported separately.

nodes.title: Check stability
nodes.body:
Vary dimension, graph, seed and reference.
Track the task outcome and diagnostic together.

nodes.title: Interpret or withhold
nodes.body:
Report conditional support, reference dependence,
representation discrepancy or an indeterminate result.

nodes.title: Reference uncertain
Outcome unsupported
Conclusion unstable
